checks.name: scope
checks.detail: CoordinateSymmetry contains only total data-producing definitions, not a theorem claiming arbitrary supplied rows/vp form a valid permutation. Soundness is supplied later by Grouped.Check=true and Grouped.check_good.

checks.name: row extraction direction
checks.detail: rows uses inputs.foldr inject, so input0 contributes row bit0, input1 bit1, etc. inject consumes successive low bits of each input word across coordinate positions and retains the accumulator length.

checks.name: vertex action direction
checks.detail: act vp row maps destination positionj to Fast.bit row (vp[j]) and folds with Nat.bit/zero tail. This matches source(row)=sum_j row[vp[j]]*2^j. No permutation hypothesis is silently assumed.

checks.name: stable pairing and halves
checks.detail: half stably groups original and transformed rows, zips them and sorts destination/source index pairs by destination. full constructs negative and positive halves independently and offsets only the positive source indices byk.

checks.name: malformed inputs and defaults
checks.detail: take/drop and zip are total and zip may truncate; insufficient rowBits/indexBits or mismatching row multiplicities are not assumed impossible. Any resulting list must still pass Grouped.Check length, range permutation, half membership and full forbidden-pool checks before Full.Good follows.
